final: WITH step1 AS (SELECT telescref, AVG(pulsepersec) AS avg_pulse FROM signals GROUP BY telescref), step2 AS (SELECT AVG(avg_pulse) AS overall_avg FROM step1), step3 AS (SELECT s.telescref, s.avg_pulse, s.avg_pulse - o.overall_avg AS difference FROM step1 AS s CROSS JOIN step2 AS o WHERE o.overall_avg IS NOT NULL AND s.avg_pulse > o.overall_avg), step4 AS (SELECT AVG(avg_pulse) AS above_avg FROM step3), step5 AS (SELECT s.avg_pulse, s.difference, s.avg_pulse - a.above_avg AS second_difference FROM step3 AS s CROSS JOIN step4 AS a WHERE a.above_avg IS NOT NULL AND s.avg_pulse > a.above_avg) SELECT AVG(avg_pulse), AVG(difference), AVG(second_difference) FROM step5
